3220-4279-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3220-4279-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2079-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2743-8229.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
2743-8229.description:
Activate Loki by paying {U} and tapping it, causing each creature you control other than Biovisionary to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each creature you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

579-3360-6006.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}{R} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1453-3899-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-3899-4694-7306.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-3841--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-3841--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2738-3967-4871-5075.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3459-4410-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Hermetic Study by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

643-3413-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-1879-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-1879-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1603-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1603-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1603-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3490-5231-5789-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-5789-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4050-6719-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6719-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1806-1887-2060-3967-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

775-1409-2499.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve both Jewel Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6005-6747-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sami.
Repeat.

3967-6517-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4050-4316-5078-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

250-779-1315-1479-3585.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-3585.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1003-4053-5226-6989.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3259-5722-6968.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-6968.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

2034-5003-6773-6965.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

147-3495-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3495-5256.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3495-5256.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

4067-4823-6281-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4067-4823-6281-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

240-526-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
240-526-6797.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

2018-5226-5570.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-2757-4826-5552.notablePrerequisites:
Archelos is untapped.
You control at least ten permanents.
You control a basic Forest.
2034-2757-4826-5552.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ojer Kaslem, untapping the Forest.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to Archelos.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

224-5310-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-5310-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

1689-2292-2351.notablePrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
You control at least one additional creature.
1689-2292-2351.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
If the creature was a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers, putting a stun counter on a nonland permanent and untapping target Kraken.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

751-3314-3470-5233.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

643-876-1656-4421-4951.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
643-876-1656-4421-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Necrotic Ooze from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necrotic Ooze enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Necrotic Ooze's toughness.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Priest of Fell Rites' toughness.
Repeat.
